text:
A silly idea I had on hold for some time, I decided to add little animations and optimize a bit the generator/solver. Could become a full game someday.
(The conversion from stateless to stateful could perhaps be applicable to other pencil-and-paper games, although the rules and UI could be tricky...)
<https://youtu.be/36j6ytVIL-g>
